# How to update Python version?

On this step-by-step guide you'll find how to update python version on all mayor Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS and Linux) making use of Chocolatey, Homebrew and Deadsnakes as well with the option to download and install from python.org

9 min read·Last updated

**Short answer:** To update Python, install the newer version with the tools of your operating system.

On Windows, run `choco upgrade python -y` in PowerShell or use the installer from python.org;

on macOS, install pyenv with `brew install pyenv` and run `pyenv install` ;

on Linux, add the deadsnakes PPA and run `sudo apt install python3.x` (the version you need).

Check the result with `python -V`.

Here is a way to update Python on Windows, Mac or Linux (commands vary depending on the operating system):

bash

```
